scheme_name: Scheme of Grant-in-Aid for Professional Associations/ Organisations of Social Scientists including Universities, Colleges and Research Institutes for Publication/ Running of their Research Journal(s)
description:
The Scheme of Grant-in-Aid for Professional Associations or Organisations of Social Scientists including Universities, Colleges and Research Institutes for Publication or Running of their Research Journal(s) was launched by the Ministry of Education, Government of India.

This scheme was initiated in the year 2019 to promote research and publication in the social sciences.

The primary objective of this scheme is to support professional associations and organisations in the social sciences to publish their research journals.

The scheme aims to enhance the quality of research publications in the field of social sciences.

It also seeks to encourage interdisciplinary research and collaboration among various institutions.

The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible organisations for the publication of their research journals.

The financial assistance is aimed at covering the costs associated with editorial management, printing, and distribution of research journals.

The maximum grant amount available under this scheme is ₹10 lakh per year.

The grant is intended to support the publication of journals that are peer-reviewed and adhere to academic standards.

Eligible organisations must demonstrate a commitment to promoting research in social sciences.

The scheme is open to universities, colleges, and research institutes that are recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC).

Professional associations that focus on social sciences are also eligible to apply for this grant.

The eligibility criteria specify that the applicant organisation must have been operational for at least three years.

The organisation must have a track record of publishing research in social sciences.

The application process involves submitting a detailed proposal to the Ministry of Education.

The proposal must outline the objectives of the journal, the target audience, and the expected impact on the field of social sciences.

Applicants must include a budget detailing how the grant funds will be utilized.

The application must also provide information on the editorial board and the peer-review process.

Required documents for the application include the registration certificate of the organisation, a list of publications, and the curriculum vitae of the editorial board members.

The Ministry of Education reviews the applications based on the quality of the proposal and the potential impact of the journal.

The review process typically takes about three months from the date of submission.

Once approved, the grant is disbursed in two installments.

The first installment of 70% of the total grant is released upon approval.

The remaining 30% is released upon submission of the utilization certificate and the final report.

The timeline for the entire process from application submission to grant disbursement can take approximately six months.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Higher Education under the Ministry of Education.

Contact details for inquiries related to the scheme can be obtained from the official Ministry of Education website.

The scheme encourages the publication of journals that are indexed in reputable databases.

It also promotes the use of open access models to enhance the visibility of research.

The scheme aims to foster a culture of research and publication among social scientists in India.

It is expected that the journals supported by this scheme will contribute to the body of knowledge in social sciences.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Government of India to enhance research output in various disciplines.

The government recognizes the importance of social sciences in addressing societal challenges.

The scheme is aligned with the National Education Policy 2020 which emphasizes the need for quality research.

The total budget allocated for this scheme in the financial year 2022-2023 was ₹20 crore.

The government aims to support at least 200 journals annually through this scheme.

The scheme also encourages collaboration between different institutions and disciplines.

It is expected that successful applicants will share best practices and contribute to the development of research methodologies.

The scheme has provisions for monitoring and evaluation to ensure effective utilization of funds.

Organisations are encouraged to report on the impact of their publications on policy and practice.

The Ministry of Education conducts periodic reviews of the scheme to assess its effectiveness.

Feedback from stakeholders is taken into account for future improvements to the scheme.

The scheme is a significant step towards strengthening the research ecosystem in social sciences in India.

It aims to create a sustainable model for the publication of high-quality research journals.

The scheme also supports capacity building initiatives for editors and researchers involved in journal publication.

It is anticipated that this will lead to improved standards in research publication.

The scheme is part of the government's commitment to enhancing the quality of higher education in India.

The Ministry of Education encourages all eligible organisations to take advantage of this grant.

The scheme is expected to have a long-term impact on the research landscape in social sciences.

Through this initiative, the government aims to promote a vibrant academic community in the field of social sciences.

The scheme is an important resource for organisations looking to enhance their research output.

It provides a platform for social scientists to disseminate their findings to a wider audience.

The government is committed to fostering an environment conducive to research and innovation.

This scheme is a vital component of the government's strategy to promote excellence in higher education.

It is designed to empower social scientists and enhance their contributions to society.

Overall, the Scheme of Grant-in-Aid for Professional Associations or Organisations of Social Scientists is a comprehensive initiative aimed at bolstering the research and publication landscape in India.
